title: CGC Gate 2.0 Layer Adaptive Edge Cloud PD Disaggregation Summary
subtitle: Layer-adaptive edge-cloud PD disaggregation summary for UI and dashboard consumption

headline.summary: Gate 2.0 is fully closed in the authoritative gate map: all 52 capabilities are now tracked as done, including the merged Gate 2.1/2.2/2.3 runtime layers and the current upkg39 four-instance runtime chain.

status_breakdown.label: Done
status_breakdown.description: Stable evidence exists and formal Gate 2.0 foundation or validated product-chain wording is allowed.

status_breakdown.label: Proof
status_breakdown.description: Formal gate or whitepaper evidence strongly proves Gate 2.0 readiness, but the final layer-adaptive closure is not yet claimed.

status_breakdown.label: Target
status_breakdown.description: Capability belongs to the formal Gate 2.0 boundary, but is not yet claimable as completed.

status_breakdown.label: Stub
status_breakdown.description: Verifier-only, adapter-only, or report-driven capability without credible runtime closure.

validation_snapshot.summary: Gate 2.0 now reflects an audited split of 32 done, 10 proof, 5 target, and 5 stub capabilities in the full gate map. Host1 / Host2 verifier closure now covers SGLang TP4EP4 prefill foundation, DeepSeek-V4-Flash resume/decode, Ray dual-host service topology, ColossalAI candidate runtime, the three-capability g21 fusion-governance family, the full g22 KV cache optimization quartet, the seven-capability g22 DeepEP L20N family, g23 R-SWA, GDS/NFSoRDMA, TrueOrthoKDA adapter, cloud L20N TP4 adaptation, and the primary g23 SGLang backend integration bucket.
